<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Sedacthy Scout](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3178)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Scouts, usually young sedacthies, ply the ocean in search of animal servants or tread ashore to hunt. Scouts hunting on the surface press [crocodiles](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2887) and [snakes](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=473) into service, while those underwater prefer [electric eels](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2970) and [hippocampi](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3050).

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Sedacthy_Scout.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Sedacthy Scout](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3178)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Amphibious" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=529" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
<trait label="Sedacthy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=770" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 300

**Perception** +9; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [wavesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=84) 30 feet

**Languages**
[Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113); sea speech

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +8, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +9, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +8, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** +0

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Sea Speech** A sedacthy speaking [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113) can be understood by any animal that has a swim Speed or the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=529) or [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=533) trait. By spending a week regularly interacting with such an animal, the sedacthy can make it permanently [helpful](/Conditions.aspx?ID=78).

**Items**
[Spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=10)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +7 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 30

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, swim 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spear +10,
**Damage** 1d6+6 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +10,
**Damage** 1d4+4 piercing plus 1d4 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29)

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 slashing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spear +10 ([thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 piercing

**Shared Feast** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The sedacthy makes a jaws Strike. If it hits, an ally of their choice can spend a reaction to make a jaws Strike against the same target. Allies with beaks or similar attacks can use those instead of jaws.

**Wriggling Rush** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The scout takes a Stride action and a [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) action, in either order. They ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) from mud, quicksand, and similar terrain during this movement.

</column>
